summary: Reynolds-style steering maths. Each function returns a force to add, not a position.
overview: Classic steering formulas as plain static maths: seek, flee, arrive, wander and flock. Each returns a steering FORCE to add to current velocity, not a velocity or a position — that is the distinction that makes them composable. SteeringAgent is the component that applies them.
useCases: Smooth pursuit that curves rather than turning on the spot.
Combining behaviours by summing their forces with weights.

gotchas.title: A force, not a velocity
gotchas.body: Using the return value as a velocity gives movement that snaps rather than steers. It is meant to be added to what the agent is already doing.
